summary: The run fixes its technical account (RunSynchronizationUseCase.cs:86) before it takes observedAt (:472); an account change saved in between gives sightings later than the change for a list read as the old account, so a later loss is marked "not in Classroom" instead of "not visible" (BR-049). Address at DB_DESIGN/IMPLEMENTATION or accept.
The digest does not say that a connection saved before the update has no account-change instant (spec FR-002.3), so courses lost then get "not in Classroom".
